commands:
set -e
conf=/etc/nginx/conf.d/gemtek-http-proxy.conf
map=/etc/nginx/conf.d/gemtek-studio-agent-origin.conf
cp -p "$conf" "$conf.before-codex-20260913"
if [ -f "$map" ]; then cp -p "$map" "$map.before-codex-20260913"; fi
printf '%s\n' 'map_hash_bucket_size 128;' '' 'map $http_origin $gemtek_studio_origin {' '    default $http_origin;' '    "https://studio.connectedenterprise.app" "https://gemtek.connectedenterprise.app";' '}' '' 'map $uri $gemtek_studio_agent_origin {' '    default $http_origin;' '    "/api/twin-agent/chat" $gemtek_studio_origin;' '}' > "$map"
if ! grep -q 'proxy_set_header Origin $gemtek_studio_agent_origin;' "$conf"; then
  sed -i '/proxy_pass https:\/\/\$gemtek_origin\$request_uri;/a\        proxy_set_header Origin $gemtek_studio_agent_origin;' "$conf"
fi
if ! nginx -t; then
  cp -p "$conf.before-codex-20260913" "$conf"
  if [ -f "$map.before-codex-20260913" ]; then cp -p "$map.before-codex-20260913" "$map"; else rm -f "$map"; fi
  exit 1
fi
systemctl reload nginx
curl -sS -o /tmp/studio-agent-after.out -w '%{http_code}' -H 'Origin: https://studio.connectedenterprise.app' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{}' https://studio.connectedenterprise.app/api/twin-agent/chat
echo
curl -sS -o /tmp/studio-agent-foreign.out -w '%{http_code}' -H 'Origin: https://unrelated.example' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{}' https://studio.connectedenterprise.app/api/twin-agent/chat
echo
